package: Agent Action Manifest public reference package
scope: Parallel v0.4.0 public reference package, including the v0.3.8 documentation clarifications and opt-in aggregate, context, delegation, and campaign controls. The existing v0.3.7 release directory is not updated.

diagram.render_note: PDF regenerated directly from the editable source with Diagram_Source/render_diagrams.py (ReportLab and Arial); not exported by draw.io. All source labels were checked against extracted PDF text and all pages were visually inspected. The Word overview was replaced with the first PDF page raster at its original aspect ratio.

tests.clean_environment: Fresh Python 3.12.14 virtual environment under /tmp with dependencies installed from python/requirements.txt.
tests.scope_note: Historical release validation retained. The full release suite was not rerun for the 2026-09-20 documentation consistency update; current focused checks are recorded under consistency_review.

limitations: All execution checks use synthetic fixtures and adapters. Word documents were rendered with the bundled LibreOffice-based renderer. The diagram PDF was regenerated from the editable source with the repository renderer and visually verified; it was not exported by draw.io. The two campaign-restoration gaps documented in consistency_review remain open. No GitHub Actions run, live service integration, independent security audit, distributed budget-coordinator test or production deployment was performed.

publication_checks.scope: Clean publication export containing exactly the checksum-manifest files.
publication_checks.checkout_scan_note: The broad checkout scan flags residual event branding in pre-existing untracked .idea/workspace.xml. The IDE metadata is not included in the package and was not changed.

open_runtime_followups: Block campaign restoration while matching executions are DISPATCHED or EXECUTION_UNKNOWN.
Bind campaign proposals to a durable monotonic revision so a hold cycle cannot revive pre-hold proposals.
